_source: Serialized verbatim-in-value from resources/epi_logos_coordinate_system.md (canonical copy of context/epi_logos_coordinate_system.md). Positions: §II Day Positions, lines 67-123. Semantic duals, questions, QL units, L-links per position block. Elements: P5=Salt explicit at line 115; full position->element mapping from the L2' element-bearing lens 6-fold, lines 451-456 (.0 Aether, .1 Earth, .2 Water, .3 Air, .4 Fire, .5 Salt), corroborated by the QL/MEF element column. Klein squares: §IV lines 545-591. Complementary pairs: lines 181, 593-595. No values invented.
_notation: The base alignment. Six Day positions P0-P5 (Torus, orientable/explicate); each has its Night inversion P0'-P5' (Klein extension). ql_unit is the Day/(No)Name unit; ql_unit_night is the Night/Power unit (complementarity per line 181).

positions.question: Why?
positions.note: The ever-present Origin; the single 0-cell to which all 1-cells attach (bindu / basepoint).

positions.question: What?
positions.note: First emergence of explicit form; identity established through vital connection.

positions.question: How?
positions.note: Active process and energic operation; defined form begins to move and transform.

positions.question: Who / Which / Whereby?
positions.note: Perspectival recognition; operational dynamics crystallise into repeatable patterns and agency.

positions.question: Where / When / Whither?
positions.note: Lemniscate anchor. The aperture where the context-frame fires and the () operator ignites; generates the .0-.5 internal positions the L-lenses receive.

positions.question: Why-for / Why-not?
positions.note: Quintessence. Mobius return: P5->P0 (Torus, ground renewed) and P5->P0' (Klein, the Twist). pros hen / focal-meaning point (analogia).

A.name: Speech-Number Axis
A.note: Holds the two implicate poles (0 and 5) and their Night inversions; governs potential<->expression, silence<->speech, number<->word.

B.name: Cause-Experience Axis
B.note: The science-experience bridge; objective structure (L1) <-> subjective appearance (L4). Basin for the /Self/Thought/ field.

C.name: Logic-Process Axis
C.note: Logical structure <-> actual process; historical macro-scale (L3') <-> alchemical micro-scale (L2'). Grounds the tetralemma and transformative process work.
